name: Samaritan Behavioral Health
description: Counseling and crisis care in Montgomery County, partly funded by the county mental health board.

location.address: 601 Edwin C. Moses Blvd., Fourth Floor

eligibility: People in Montgomery County who need counseling or crisis care.

steps: Call 937-734-8333 to ask for an assessment.
In a crisis, call or text 988, or go to the nearest emergency room.
